name: Can I convert my mobile home tub into a shower during a remodel?

mainEntity.name: Can I convert my mobile home tub into a shower during a remodel?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, converting a tub into a shower is a common and often beneficial upgrade in mobile home bathroom remodels, especially for maximizing space or improving accessibility. This conversion typically involves removing the existing tub, modifying plumbing for a shower pan and drain, and installing a new shower surround or tile. It's important to consider the existing floor structure and ensure it can support the new shower setup, especially if tiling. City Dweller, LLC can assess your current bathroom and recommend the best approach for a safe and effective tub-to-shower conversion.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, you can convert a mobile home tub to a shower during a remodel, which can improve space and accessibility. Consider existing plumbing and structural support for the conversion.
